findings.explanation: This clause requires you to perform extra work requested by the client for free, creating open-ended scope creep with no extra pay.
findings.suggested_change: The Contractor shall perform additional services requested by the Client only upon execution of a written change order detailing the scope and agreed fees.

findings.explanation: Unlimited revisions allow the client to demand changes endlessly without extra compensation, trapping you in a never-ending loop of work.
findings.suggested_change: The Client may request up to two (2) rounds of revisions per Deliverable. Additional revisions will be billed at the Contractor's standard hourly rate.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello, I hope this email finds you well. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before I sign it. Here are the points I would like to discuss: 
- Regarding the clause stating 'Contractor shall also perform any additional services Client reasonably requests during the Term at no additional charge.', this requires performing extra work for free; I propose changing this so that additional services are performed only upon execution of a written change order detailing the scope and agreed fees. 
- Regarding the clause stating 'Client may request unlimited revisions until Client is fully satisfied with each Deliverable.', this creates an open-ended loop; I propose changing this so the client may request up to two rounds of revisions per deliverable, with additional revisions billed at my standard hourly rate. 
- Regarding the clause stating 'Revision allowance: unlimited', this also allows endless changes; I propose changing this to 'Revision allowance: up to three rounds of revisions per deliverable.' 
Thank you for your understanding, and I look forward to moving forward together. Best regards.
